question: Pandit Ram Narayan, an Indian musician, was credited with popularising the musical instrument ________ as a solo concert instrument.
solution:
The correct answer is __**sarangi**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pandit Ram Narayan**, an Indian musician, was credited with popularising the musical instrument **sarangi **as a solo concert instrument.
 
• ​He is a Hindustani classical musician who plays the bowed instrument, the sarangi.
 
• He is credited with popularizing the sarangi as a solo classical instrument.
 
• He was born in 1927 in Amber village in Rajasthan.
 
• A sarangi is a bowed stringed instrument with a skin-covered resonator.
